description: This source file defines functions related to decoding and configuring trigger signals for a fuel injection or engine control system, specifically for VW trigger decoding. It includes functions to set up trigger shape configurations, add trigger events, and establish synchronization gaps.

methods.name: void setVwConfiguration(TriggerShape * s)
methods.description: Configures the trigger shape for a VW engine, initializes trigger shape, sets synchronization, and adds trigger events based on engine cycle and tooth count.
